_comment: The curated mod list for Night City Online. Cam and the devs decide what is on it;
the launcher installs and verifies against it so everyone is running the same game.
Published as a release asset, so the list can change without shipping a launcher.
WHY EACH FIELD EXISTS
nexusModId    identifies the mod on Nexus. The launcher asks Nexus for the name,
summary and current file, so nothing here has to be kept in step by
hand - and nobody has to guess a name they have not read.
nexusFileId   OPTIONAL. Pin this to freeze a mod at one exact file, so an upstream
update cannot change what everyone is running mid-session. Left out,
the launcher takes the current main file and records which one it
installed, so a later change is still detectable.
requires      nexusModIds this one needs first. A mod installed before its
framework does not fail loudly - the game starts and the mod is
simply absent, or crashes somewhere unrelated. The launcher sorts
the list into install order and refuses to install anything whose
requirements are missing.
required      required mods block Play. Optional ones do not - a cosmetic choice
should never stop someone joining.
devOnly       shown and installable only to staff. For anything that would let a
player change the world - which on this server only they would see,
since the world is not synchronised.
sha256        OPTIONAL. Verified after install when present.
The six prerequisites are NOT here. They ship inside FullInstall.zip because they are
MIT licensed and redistributable. Nexus mods are not ours to redistribute, which is
the whole reason this list points at Nexus rather than hosting the files.

mods.note: Fast Launch - skips every startup video straight to the main menu. Pairs with the launcher's -skipStartScreen arg for a no-wait boot.
Cam: good for police and prison RP.
